'''Kyood's World''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]],<ref name="EA" /> located on the fringe of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], at the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}}</ref> Kyood's World was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
A complete list of the worlds of the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
